'''Marca''', the [[Sekct]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Marcellus Nebula]].

About thirty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Dynamic Synergetics, Inc.]] established a [[Hyperbaride/Legends|Hyperbaride]] synthesis plant on the surface. It was overseen by former retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Vost Tyne]] after DSI was nationalized.

Later, a group of agents working for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] accidentally stumbled onto the planet while en route to [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]]. After crashing on the world, the Rebels made contact with a group of local Sekct and managed to destroy the DSI plant.

[[Flutterer]]s, [[mosrk'teck]]s, [[swamp serpent]]s, [[swamp shark]]s, [[thunder lizard]]s and [[water glider]]s were just some of the animals native to Marca.
